items.title: LawClaw – Constitutional governance for AI agents (MIT)
items.raw_excerpt: Most AI agents today run with unchecked access to tools like shell execution, database writes, and arbitrary HTTP calls. There's no systematic way to constrain what they can do before execution happens. You're essentially giving a new employee root access and no employment contract. LawClaw applies a separation-of-powers model to agent governance — borrowing from constitutional design to create layered, enforceable rules. Three layers: Constitution: Immutable core rules embedded in the system prompt. The agent cannot override these regardless of user instruction. Legislature: Detailed behavioral laws written as plain markdown files. Human-readable, git-diffable, no custom DSL. Change the law by editing a file and committing. Pre-Judiciary: Automated enforcement that runs before tool execut

items.title: Secret Sanitizer – auto-masks secrets when you paste into AI chats
items.raw_excerpt: I kept pasting code with hardcoded API keys, database credentials, and auth tokens into ChatGPT while debugging. Copy a failing function, paste it into AI, and realise your AWS secret key or Stripe token was right there in the snippet. So I built (with some help from Claude) a simple Chrome extension that intercepts the paste, detects secrets using local regex, and replaces them with [MASKED] before they reach the chat. Originals stay in a local AES-256 encrypted vault for unmasking. No servers. No network requests. No tracking. ~41 KB, zero dependencies. Don't take my word for it: 'grep -r "fetch\|XMLHttpRequest" content_script.js' returns nothing. Works on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, DeepSeek, and any custom site you add. Supports 30+ patterns — AWS keys, GitHub tokens, JW

title_i18n.en:
Title: Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan Launches New Models, Supporting Qwen 3.5, GLM-4.7, and More  
Title: Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan Offers Promotion, 18,000 Requests Starting at Just 7.9 Yuan
title_i18n.es: Título: Nuevas incorporaciones en el Plan de Codificación de Alibaba Cloud, compatible con modelos como Qwen 3.5 y GLM-4.7. Título: El Plan de Codificación de Alibaba Cloud lanza una oferta promocional, con un mínimo de 7,9 yuanes por 18.000 solicitudes.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2月22日，阿里云Coding Plan订阅服务新增支持Qwen3.5-Plus、Qwen3-Coder-Next、GLM-4.7、Kimi-K2.5共4款顶尖编程模型，用户无需更改订阅和配置即可自由切换。阿里云Coding Plan还上线了优惠活动，即日起，新用户首购可享2折优惠，首月18000次请求额度仅需7.9元，90000次请求仅需39.9元。   AI Agent是目前大模型的主要应用载体，业界已涌现Claude Code、OpenClaw等爆火的AI工具。但Agent需要执行复杂任务，并进行多轮规划与工具调用，Tokens消耗量呈指数级增长，有数据显示，单个Agent的算力消耗是传统Chatbot的100至1000倍 。为此，阿里云推出Coding Plan订阅服务，为用户提供性价比更高、可自由选择的模型服务。 阿里云Coding Plan共有Lite基础版和Pro高级版两个套餐，其中，Lite基础套餐可享受每月最多18000次请求，新用户购买首月仅需7.9元；Pro高级套餐可享受每月90000次请求，可完成数千次复杂任务，新用户首月仅需39.9元，极大地降低高频次编码需求场景的成本。用户可在Qwen Code、Claude Code、Cline、OpenClaw等主流AI工具使用阿里云Coding Plan订阅服务。 此前，阿里云百炼已上线全新的Qwen3.5-Plus，其API价格低至每百万Tokens 0.8元，用户仅需不到5%的价格即可获得媲美Gemini 3的高性能。现在，阿里云Coding Plan的上新进一步降低了模型的使用成本，让用户真正享受到模型自由。 据介绍，目前阿里云百炼平台已上线100多款国内外主流模型，同时为开发者提供了400多个AI硬件、短视频及广告内容等领域的Agent模板与服务。
excerpt_i18n.en:
On February 22, Alibaba Cloud's Coding Plan subscription service added support for four top-tier programming models: Qwen3.5-Plus, Qwen3-Coder-Next, GLM-4.7, and Kimi-K2.5. Users can freely switch between these models without changing subscriptions or configurations. Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan also launched a promotional offer: starting now, new users can enjoy an 80% discount on their first purchase, with 18,000 requests for the first month priced at just 7.9 yuan, and 90,000 requests at 39.9 yuan.  

AI Agents are currently the primary application carriers for large models, with popular tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw emerging in the industry. However, Agents require executing complex tasks and involve multi-round planning and tool calls, leading to an exponential increase in token consumption. Data shows that the computational power consumption of a single Agent is 100 to 1,000 times that of traditional chatbots. To address this, Alibaba Cloud introduced the Coding Plan subscription service, offering users more cost-effective and flexible model options.  

Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan includes two packages: Lite Basic and Pro Advanced. The Lite Basic package offers up to 18,000 requests per month, with the first month priced at just 7.9 yuan for new users. The Pro Advanced package provides 90,000 requests per month, capable of completing thousands of complex tasks, with the first month priced at 39.9 yuan for new users, significantly reducing costs for high-frequency usage.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 22 de febrero, el servicio de suscripción de Coding Plan de Aliyun añadió soporte para cuatro modelos de programación de vanguardia: Qwen3.5-Plus, Qwen3-Coder-Next, GLM-4.7 y Kimi-K2.5. Los usuarios pueden cambiar libremente entre ellos sin necesidad de modificar suscripciones o configuraciones. Además, Coding Plan de Aliyun ha lanzado una promoción: desde hoy, los nuevos usuarios disfrutan de un 80% de descuento en su primera compra, con 18,000 solicitudes por solo 7,9 yuanes el primer mes, y 90,000 solicitudes por solo 39,9 yuanes. AI Agent es actualmente el principal vehículo de aplicación para los grandes modelos, y en la industria ya han surgido ejemplos como Claude C.

items.title: How Taalas "prints" LLM onto a chip?
items.raw_excerpt: A startup called Taalas , recently released an ASIC chip running Llama 3.1 8B (3/6 bit quant) at an inference rate of 17,000 tokens per seconds. That's like writing around 30 A4 sized pages in one second. They claim it's 10x cheaper in ownership cost than GPU based inference systems and is 10x less electricity hog. And yeah, about 10x faster than state of art inference.

items.title: The Human Root of Trust – public domain framework for agent accountability
items.raw_excerpt: I've spent my career at the intersection of identity, trust, and distributed systems. The thing I keep thinking about: every digital system we've built assumes a human is on the other end. Bank accounts, contracts, API keys — all designed around human singularity. That assumption has already broken. AI agents are transacting, communicating, and signing contracts autonomously — passing identity checks designed for people, with no human visibly in the loop. The Human Root of Trust is my attempt to name the problem and sketch the architecture: three pillars (proof of humanity, hardware-rooted device identity, action attestation), a six-step trust chain from human principal to cryptographic receipt, and two implementation paths. It's dedicated to the public domain. No patent. No product. No as

La empresa indicó que los fondos se destinarán a investigación de vanguardia, desarrollo de productos y expansión de infraestructura, con el objetivo de posicionarse como líder en el mercado de inteligencia artificial empresarial y codificación.

items.title: AI 是否已经杀死了敏捷宣言
items.raw_excerpt: 凯捷集团执行副总裁 Steve Jones 在 Medium博文 及相关的 LinkedIn帖子 中宣称“AI 已杀死敏捷宣言”，引发了激烈辩论。Jones 认为，在 智能体软件开发生命周期（SDLC）系统 中，AI 智能体承担了大量开发工作，这与敏捷宣言的四大核心价值观和十二条原则存在根本性矛盾。

title_i18n.zh: AI 是否已经杀死了敏捷宣言
title_i18n.en: Has AI already killed the Agile Manifesto?
title_i18n.es: ¿Ha matado la IA al Manifiesto Ágil?

excerpt_i18n.zh: 凯捷集团执行副总裁 Steve Jones 在 Medium博文 及相关的 LinkedIn帖子 中宣称“AI 已杀死敏捷宣言”，引发了激烈辩论。Jones 认为，在 智能体软件开发生命周期（SDLC）系统 中，AI 智能体承担了大量开发工作，这与敏捷宣言的四大核心价值观和十二条原则存在根本性矛盾。
excerpt_i18n.en: Capgemini Executive Vice President Steve Jones sparked intense debate by claiming in a Medium blog post and related LinkedIn posts that "AI has killed the Agile Manifesto." Jones argues that in agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC) systems, AI agents take on a significant portion of development work, fundamentally conflicting with the four core values and twelve principles of the Agile Manifesto.
excerpt_i18n.es: Steve Jones, vicepresidente ejecutivo del Grupo Capgemini, afirmó en un artículo de Medium y en una publicación relacionada en LinkedIn que "la IA ha matado el Manifiesto Ágil", desatando un intenso debate. Jones sostiene que, en los sistemas de ciclo de vida de desarrollo de software (SDLC) basados en agentes de IA, estos agentes asumen gran parte del trabajo de desarrollo, lo que contradice fundamentalmente los cuatro valores centrales y los doce principios del Manifiesto Ágil.
